examples.en: He missed school because of illness.
She recovered from a serious illness.
examples.zh: 她从一场重病中康复了。

mnemonic.tip: ill(生病的)+ness(状态),处于生病的状态就是疾病。

examples.en: Take this medicine twice a day.
She studies medicine at university.

mnemonic.tip: medi(治疗,同 medical)+cine,用来治病的东西就是药。

examples.en: The doctor saw ten patients today.
examples.zh: 医生今天看了十位病人。

examples.en: Please be patient and wait.

mnemonic.tip: 看病要排队,能忍着痛"耐心"等的人就是 patient(病人),一词两义。

examples.en: I have a bad headache today.
Too much screen time gives me a headache.
examples.zh: 看屏幕太久会让我头痛。

mnemonic.tip: head(头)+ache(疼),头疼就是 headache;同理 toothache 牙疼。

examples.en: I ate too much and got a stomachache.
A stomachache kept her awake.

mnemonic.tip: stomach(胃)+ache(疼),胃疼就是 stomachache。

examples.en: I feel a sharp pain in my leg.
The medicine took away the pain.

mnemonic.tip: pain 谐音"疼"——发音就带着疼劲儿。

examples.en: She has a high fever.
The child's fever went down at night.

mnemonic.tip: fever 谐音"发我"——发烧时全身滚烫"发"着热。

examples.en: He coughed all night.
I have a bad cough.

mnemonic.tip: cough 谐音"咳夫"——发音本身就像"咳"的一声。

examples.en: I caught a cold last week.
Stay warm so you don't get a cold.

mnemonic.tip: cold 本义"冷",受了凉就 catch a cold(感冒)。

examples.en: Many students had the flu this winter.
examples.zh: 这个冬天很多学生得了流感。

examples.en: The flu made him stay in bed.

mnemonic.tip: flu 是 influenza 的缩写,比普通感冒(cold)更凶的流行性感冒。

examples.en: He has a knee injury from football.
Wear a helmet to avoid injury.

mnemonic.tip: in(不)+jur(公正,同 justice)+y,被不公正地伤了身=受伤。

examples.en: The nurse put a bandage on my arm.
examples.zh: 护士在我手臂上缠了绷带。

examples.en: He wore a bandage for a week.

mnemonic.tip: band(带子)+age,缠伤口的带子就是绷带。

examples.en: The treatment lasted two weeks.
She received treatment at the hospital.

mnemonic.tip: treat(治疗/对待)+ment,治病的过程就是 treatment。

examples.en: This medicine can cure the illness.
There is no cure for a cold.

mnemonic.tip: cure 谐音"克尔"——把病"克"掉就是治愈。

examples.en: He is recovering from an operation.
She recovered quickly after resting.

mnemonic.tip: re(重新)+cover(覆盖/盖上),重新把健康"盖"回身上就是康复。

examples.en: Running improves your fitness.
She goes to a fitness centre.

mnemonic.tip: fit(健康的/合身的)+ness(状态),身体处于"fit"的状态就是健康。

examples.en: I want to lose some weight.
The doctor checked my weight.

mnemonic.tip: weight 里有 weigh(称重),称出来的数就是重量/体重。

examples.en: Go to the dentist twice a year.
The dentist checked my teeth.

mnemonic.tip: dent(牙,拉丁 dent)+ist(人),管牙的人就是牙医。

examples.en: Buy the medicine at the chemist.
The chemist is open until nine.

mnemonic.tip: chemist 里有 chem(化学),懂药物化学、卖药配药的人/店就是 chemist。

examples.en: The doctor wrote a prescription.
You need a prescription for this medicine.

mnemonic.tip: pre(预先)+script(写,同 script)+ion,医生预先写好的用药单就是处方。

examples.en: A cough is a symptom of a cold.
examples.zh: 咳嗽是感冒的一种症状。

examples.en: Tell the doctor your symptoms.

mnemonic.tip: symptom 谐音"婶疼"——身体这儿疼那儿疼,就是显出了症状。

examples.en: He had an operation on his knee.
The operation was a success.

mnemonic.tip: oper(工作/操作,同 operate)+ation,医生在身体上"动手操作"就是手术。

examples.en: Call an ambulance quickly!
The ambulance arrived in five minutes.

mnemonic.tip: ambulance 谐音"俺不能死"——躺上救护车心里喊着"俺不能死",赶紧送医。

examples.en: I have a doctor's appointment at three.
Please make an appointment first.

mnemonic.tip: ap(朝向)+point(指定)+ment,双方指定好一个时间点见面=预约。

examples.en: I have a sore throat.
My legs are sore after running.

mnemonic.tip: sore 谐音"搜"——哪儿一碰就"嗖"地一阵酸痛。

examples.en: I felt dizzy on the boat.
Standing up too fast makes me dizzy.
examples.zh: 站起来太快会让我头晕。

mnemonic.tip: dizzy 谐音"地字"——晕的时候连地上的字都转成一团。

examples.en: Breathe in slowly and relax.
It's hard to breathe in thick smoke.

mnemonic.tip: 动词 breathe 带 e(读 /ð/),名词 breath(呼吸)不带 e;呼吸要"深"一点。

examples.en: Exercise is good for your heart.
My heart beats fast when I run.

mnemonic.tip: heart 里藏着 ear(耳)和 art(艺术),但记 heart=心脏,爱心❤就是它。

examples.en: He broke a bone in his arm.
Milk helps build strong bones.

mnemonic.tip: bone 谐音"崩"——骨头断了"崩"的一声。

examples.en: Lifting weights builds muscle.
He pulled a muscle in his leg.

mnemonic.tip: muscle 谐音"马嗖"——肌肉一使劲,像马一样嗖地爆发力量(c不发音)。

examples.en: The nurse took a little blood.
There was blood on his knee.

mnemonic.tip: blood 谐音"卜辣"——血是红的,读音短促带 oo 读 /ʌ/。

examples.en: Eating fruit keeps you healthy.
He looks strong and healthy.

mnemonic.tip: health(健康)+y,形容词就是健康的。

examples.en: Daily exercise keeps me fit.
examples.zh: 每天锻炼让我保持健康。

examples.en: You should exercise more often.

mnemonic.tip: ex(向外)+erc(约束/驱动)+ise,把身体的能量向外练出来就是锻炼。

examples.en: You need to rest when you're ill.
Have a good rest this weekend.

mnemonic.tip: rest 谐音"瑞斯特"不如记"累死"反着想——累了就该 rest 休息。

examples.en: She felt ill after lunch.
He was too ill to go to work.

mnemonic.tip: ill 两根竖线像躺在床上的病人,病恹恹的就是 ill。

examples.en: The dust made me sneeze.
Cover your mouth when you sneeze.

mnemonic.tip: sneeze 谐音"斯尼兹"——"阿嚏"一声就是打喷嚏。

examples.en: Clean the wound before covering it.
The wound healed in a week.

mnemonic.tip: wound 读音像"乌恩德"——伤口一疼就"呜"地叫。

examples.en: Washing hands prevents disease.
Heart disease is quite serious.

mnemonic.tip: dis(不)+ease(舒适),身体不舒适、失去安宁就是疾病。

examples.en: She needs medical help.
He is doing medical research.

mnemonic.tip: medi(治疗)+cal,和治病有关的就是 medical。

examples.en: Music helps me relax.
Relax and take a deep breath.

mnemonic.tip: re(重新)+lax(松弛,同 lazy的松),把绷紧的神经重新松开就是放松。

examples.en: Your brain needs sleep to work well.
examples.zh: 大脑需要睡眠才能运转良好。

examples.en: Reading is exercise for the brain.

mnemonic.tip: brain 里有 rain——脑子灵光如雨点般冒想法。

examples.en: Wear sunscreen to protect your skin.
Babies have very soft skin.

mnemonic.tip: skin 也指果皮——banana skin 香蕉皮。

examples.en: My throat hurts when I swallow.
Warm water is good for a sore throat.

mnemonic.tip: a sore throat 嗓子疼——感冒最常见的抱怨。

examples.en: He felt a pain in his chest after running.
The doctor listened to her chest.

mnemonic.tip: chest 也是大箱子——胸腔就是装心肺的"箱子"。

examples.en: She hurt her elbow when she fell off the bike.
examples.zh: 她从自行车上摔下来伤了肘部。

examples.en: Don’t put your elbows on the table.
examples.zh: 吃饭别把胳膊肘放桌上。

mnemonic.tip: L 形的 bow(弯)——手臂弯成 L 的地方是肘。

examples.en: He twisted his ankle playing basketball.
The water only came up to my ankles.

mnemonic.tip: ankle 与 angle(角度)像——脚踝正是脚转角度的地方。

examples.en: She wears a watch on her left wrist.
The goalkeeper hurt his wrist saving the ball.
examples.zh: 守门员扑球时伤了手腕。

mnemonic.tip: wrist 的 w 不发音——write(写字)全靠 wrist 转动。

examples.en: He gave me a thumbs up after the show.
examples.zh: 演出结束后他向我竖起大拇指。

examples.en: The baby likes sucking her thumb.

mnemonic.tip: thumb 的 b 不发音；thumbs up 点赞。

examples.en: The ball hit him right on the chin.
She rested her chin on her hands, thinking.

mnemonic.tip: chin 谐音"亲"——亲亲长在下巴上。

examples.en: The cold wind made her cheeks red.
Grandma kissed him on the cheek.

mnemonic.tip: cheek 谐音"气克"——生气时鼓起的就是脸颊。

examples.en: Mum touched my forehead to check for a fever.
examples.zh: 妈妈摸摸我的额头看有没有发烧。

examples.en: Sweat ran down his forehead.

mnemonic.tip: fore(前)+head(头)→头的前面→额头。

examples.en: The doctor asked to see my tongue.
examples.zh: 医生让我伸出舌头看看。

examples.en: English is not her mother tongue.

mnemonic.tip: mother tongue 母语——舌头也管说话。

examples.en: Her lips were blue with cold.
He read the words silently, moving his lips.

mnemonic.tip: lip 谐音"唇"的轻读——上唇下唇一碰就读出 lip。

examples.en: Cut your nails before the match.
He hit the nail with a hammer.

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：手上的 nail 指甲，墙上的 nail 钉子。

examples.en: The water was up to my waist.
She tied a belt around her waist.

mnemonic.tip: waist 与 waste(浪费)同音——腰粗了才知浪费吃多了。

examples.en: Smoking damages your lungs.
Take a deep breath and fill your lungs.
examples.zh: 深吸一口气，让肺装满空气。

mnemonic.tip: lung 谐音"隆"——胸腔隆起处装着肺。

examples.en: Too many sweets gave him toothache.
She saw the dentist about her toothache.

mnemonic.tip: tooth(牙)+ache(疼)→牙疼；同族 headache。

examples.en: The little boy cried because of his earache.
Swimming in cold water gave me earache.
examples.zh: 在冷水里游泳游得我耳朵疼。

mnemonic.tip: ear(耳)+ache(疼)→耳朵疼。

examples.en: Sitting all day gives Dad backache.
examples.zh: 整天坐着让爸爸腰酸背痛。

examples.en: A hard bed sometimes helps backache.
examples.zh: 硬板床有时对背疼有帮助。

mnemonic.tip: back(背)+ache(疼)→背疼。

examples.en: Wash the cut well to prevent infection.
examples.zh: 把伤口洗干净以防感染。

examples.en: She is taking medicine for an ear infection.
examples.zh: 她在吃治耳部感染的药。

mnemonic.tip: infect(感染)+ion→被病菌入侵→感染。

examples.en: Wash your hands to get rid of germs.
Coughing spreads germs.

mnemonic.tip: germ 谐音"揪母"——揪出生病的"母"源就是病菌。

examples.en: The strawberries gave her a rash.
A red rash appeared on his arm.

mnemonic.tip: rash 谐音"拉屑"——皮肤上拉起一片小屑点→皮疹。

examples.en: He got a big bruise on his knee from the fall.
examples.zh: 他摔了一跤，膝盖上一大块淤青。

examples.en: The bruise turned purple the next day.
examples.zh: 第二天淤青变成了紫色。

mnemonic.tip: bruise 谐音"不如死"——磕出淤青疼得直喊。

examples.en: Her ankle was swollen after the fall.
His eyes were swollen from crying.

mnemonic.tip: swell(肿胀)的过去分词——肿起来的。

examples.en: She fainted in the hot sun.
We heard a faint cry from far away.
examples.zh: 我们听到远处微弱的呼喊。

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：faint 晕倒；a faint sound 微弱的声音。

examples.en: Too much stress is bad for your health.
Exercise is a good way to deal with stress.
examples.zh: 运动是缓解压力的好办法。

mnemonic.tip: stress 重压之下——press(压)藏在里面。

examples.en: He needs surgery on his knee.
The doctor’s surgery opens at eight.

mnemonic.tip: 英式 surgery 也指诊所——doctor’s surgery。

examples.en: The village clinic treats small illnesses.
She took the baby to the clinic for a check.

mnemonic.tip: clinic 谐音"可里尼克"——小病去诊所，大病去 hospital。

examples.en: Grandpa is in the ward on the third floor.
The children’s ward is bright and colourful.

mnemonic.tip: ward 像 warm(温暖)少个 m——病房应是温暖的地方。

examples.en: You can buy the medicine at any pharmacy.
examples.zh: 这种药任何药店都能买到。

examples.en: The pharmacy is next to the clinic.

mnemonic.tip: pharmac(药)+y(店)→卖药的店；英式常说 chemist。

examples.en: Take one pill after each meal.
The pill was too big to swallow easily.

mnemonic.tip: pill 谐音"呸儿"——药丸苦得想吐。

examples.en: The new drug helps people with heart disease.
Say no to drugs.

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：治病的 drug 药物，害人的 drugs 毒品。

examples.en: The nurse gave me an injection in the arm.
examples.zh: 护士在我手臂上打了一针。

examples.en: The injection didn’t hurt at all.

mnemonic.tip: in(进)+ject(射)+ion→把药射进身体→注射。

examples.en: She put a plaster on the small cut.
examples.zh: 她在小伤口上贴了创可贴。

examples.en: His broken arm is in plaster.
examples.zh: 他骨折的手臂打了石膏。

mnemonic.tip: 小伤贴 plaster 创可贴，骨折上 plaster 石膏。

examples.en: The thermometer showed 39 degrees.
Put the thermometer under your tongue.

mnemonic.tip: thermo(热)+meter(计量)→量热度的仪器。

examples.en: The X-ray showed a broken bone.
The dentist took an X-ray of my teeth.

mnemonic.tip: X 射线——伦琴发现时不知是什么，就叫它 X。

examples.en: Every teacher should learn basic first aid.
examples.zh: 每位老师都该学基本急救。

examples.en: The first aid box is on the wall.

mnemonic.tip: first(第一时间)+aid(援助)→第一时间的救助→急救。

examples.en: Grandpa has a check-up every six months.
The dentist says I need a check-up.
examples.zh: 牙医说我需要做个检查。

mnemonic.tip: check(检查)+up→从头到脚查一遍→体检。

examples.en: Call 120 in a medical emergency.
examples.zh: 遇到医疗紧急情况拨打120。

examples.en: The emergency exit must never be locked.

mnemonic.tip: emerge(突然冒出)+ncy→突然冒出来的状况→紧急情况。

examples.en: The doctor sent her to a heart specialist.
examples.zh: 医生把她转给心脏专科医生。

examples.en: A specialist knows one field very deeply.
examples.zh: 专家对一个领域了解很深。

mnemonic.tip: special(专门)+ist(人)→专门研究某领域的人。

examples.en: My legs ached after the long climb.
examples.zh: 爬了很久的山，我的腿酸疼。

examples.en: His head was aching, so he went to bed.

mnemonic.tip: headache/toothache 的 ache——持续隐隐地疼。

examples.en: She suffers from bad headaches.
The team suffered a heavy defeat.

mnemonic.tip: suf(在下)+fer(承受)→在重压下承受→受苦。

examples.en: His nose was bleeding after the ball hit him.
examples.zh: 球打到他后鼻子流血了。

examples.en: Press the cut to stop it bleeding.

mnemonic.tip: blood(血)的动词兄弟——blood 名词，bleed 流血。

examples.en: Her finger began to swell after the bee sting.
examples.zh: 被蜜蜂蜇后她的手指肿了起来。

examples.en: The river swelled after days of rain.

mnemonic.tip: swell 像吹气球——越吹越大就是肿。过去分词 swollen。

examples.en: The cut healed in a week.
Time heals most wounds.
examples.zh: 时间能治愈大多数伤痛。

mnemonic.tip: heal 与 health 同根——恢复健康就是愈合。

examples.en: He injured his shoulder in the match.
Luckily, no one was injured in the accident.
examples.zh: 幸运的是事故中没人受伤。

mnemonic.tip: injury(伤)的动词——in+jur(不公)→意外带来的伤。

examples.en: The doctor examined her throat carefully.
examples.zh: 医生仔细检查了她的喉咙。

examples.en: Scientists examined the water for germs.
examples.zh: 科学家检验水里有没有细菌。

mnemonic.tip: exam(考试)的动词兄弟——医生给身体"考试"→检查。

examples.en: The doctors operated on his broken leg at once.
examples.zh: 医生立即给他的断腿做了手术。

examples.en: Do you know how to operate this machine?

mnemonic.tip: oper(工作)+ate→动手做→手术/操作；名词 operation。

examples.en: Washing hands prevents many illnesses.
The heavy rain prevented us from going out.

mnemonic.tip: pre(提前)+vent(来)→赶在问题来之前→预防。

examples.en: Eating breakfast is a good habit.
He has a habit of biting his nails.

mnemonic.tip: habit 谐音"哈比特"——霍比特人天天准点吃饭，习惯极好。

examples.en: A healthy lifestyle includes exercise and good sleep.
examples.zh: 健康的生活方式包括运动和良好睡眠。

examples.en: City and country lifestyles are very different.
examples.zh: 城市和乡村的生活方式很不同。

mnemonic.tip: life(生活)+style(风格)→生活的风格→生活方式。

examples.en: A short nap after lunch helps you learn better.
examples.zh: 午饭后小睡一会儿有助学习。

examples.en: Grandpa takes a nap every afternoon.
examples.zh: 爷爷每天下午都要打个盹。

mnemonic.tip: nap 谐音"眯"的感觉——眯一小觉。

examples.en: A good diet keeps a balance of different foods.
examples.zh: 好的饮食讲究食物搭配平衡。

examples.en: He lost his balance and fell off the wall.
examples.zh: 他失去平衡从墙上摔了下来。

mnemonic.tip: ba(双)+lance(秤盘)→两个秤盘一样重→平衡。

examples.en: The doctor was pleased with her quick recovery.
examples.zh: 医生对她的快速康复很满意。

examples.en: Rest is important for a full recovery.
examples.zh: 休息对完全康复很重要。

mnemonic.tip: recover(恢复)+y→恢复的过程→康复。

examples.en: Wear a helmet for safety.
The lifeguard is responsible for the safety of swimmers.
examples.zh: 救生员负责游泳者的安全。

mnemonic.tip: safe(安全的)+ty→安全这件事。

examples.en: Smoking increases the risk of heart disease.
Never take risks near deep water.
examples.zh: 在深水边千万不要冒险。

mnemonic.tip: risk 谐音"锐斯克"——刀锋(锐)上行走就是冒险。

examples.en: She felt weak after the long illness.
The tea is too weak for Grandpa.
examples.zh: 这茶对爷爷来说太淡了。

mnemonic.tip: weak 与 week 同音——病了一 week，人就 weak 了。

examples.en: You look pale—are you feeling all right?
Her face went pale at the bad news.
examples.zh: 听到坏消息她脸色发白。

mnemonic.tip: pale 谐音"白哦"——脸色白得吓人。

examples.en: The injection was quick but painful.
Walking was painful after the fall.

mnemonic.tip: pain(疼)+ful(充满)→充满疼痛的。

examples.en: Eating too late at night is unhealthy.
An unhealthy diet causes many problems.
examples.zh: 不健康的饮食引发很多问题。

mnemonic.tip: un(不)+healthy(健康)→不健康的。

examples.en: My grandfather is a little deaf in one ear.
examples.zh: 我爷爷一只耳朵有点背。

examples.en: The deaf girl reads lips very well.
examples.zh: 这个失聪女孩很会读唇。

mnemonic.tip: deaf 读 /def/——ea 发短 e，别读成"迪夫"。

examples.en: The blind man crosses the road with a guide dog.
She has been blind since birth.

mnemonic.tip: blind 里有 blink(眨眼)的影子——眼睛看不见了。

examples.en: The building has lifts for disabled visitors.
examples.zh: 大楼为残障访客设有电梯。

examples.en: Disabled athletes compete in the Paralympics.
examples.zh: 残疾运动员参加残奥会。

mnemonic.tip: dis(不)+abled(有能力)→身体部分功能受限的。

examples.en: He is allergic to cats.
Tell the doctor if you are allergic to any medicine.
examples.zh: 如果对药物过敏要告诉医生。

mnemonic.tip: allergy(过敏)+ic→过敏的；be allergic to。

examples.en: Mental health is as important as physical health.
examples.zh: 心理健康和身体健康同样重要。

examples.en: Chess is good mental exercise.
examples.zh: 下棋是很好的脑力锻炼。

mnemonic.tip: ment(思维)+al→与头脑有关的→心理的。

examples.en: Physical exercise keeps your heart strong.
The job needs a lot of physical strength.

mnemonic.tip: physic(身体/自然)+al→身体的；physics 物理同根。

examples.en: The doctor says the dog is overweight.
Being overweight puts stress on your heart.
examples.zh: 超重会给心脏增加负担。

mnemonic.tip: over(超过)+weight(体重)→超过正常体重的。

examples.en: She stays slim by swimming every day.
examples.zh: 她靠每天游泳保持苗条。

examples.en: He is tall and slim like his father.
examples.zh: 他像爸爸一样又高又瘦。

mnemonic.tip: sl- 词族都细长：slim 苗条、slender 修长、slice 薄片。

examples.en: Carrots are said to be good for your sight.
The sunrise over the sea is a beautiful sight.
examples.zh: 海上日出是美丽的景象。

mnemonic.tip: see(看)的名词亲戚——sight 看的能力和看到的景象。

examples.en: Loud music can damage your hearing.
examples.zh: 大音量音乐会损伤听力。

examples.en: Dogs have much better hearing than people.

mnemonic.tip: hear(听)+ing→听的能力→听力。
